title: ONAM: Fitting Orthogonal Neural Additive Models for Post-Hoc Interpretability of Black-Box Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2611.21550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern machine learning models, such as artificial neural networks, achieve high predictive performance through increasingly complex black-box architectures, limiting their use in settings where transparency, interpretability, and fairness are required. Here we present the R package ONAM, which provides a novel and practical implementation of functional decomposition, a technique to facilitate the interpretability of black-box models through structured effect representations. ONAM implements an algorithmic framework for the post-hoc decomposition of predictions into components associated with different input features. The package is designed for usability and efficiency, including functionalities for visualization as well as quantitative measures to assess interpretability. translated_title: ONAM：拟合正交神经加性模型以实现黑盒预测的事后可解释性
translated_abstract: 现代机器学习模型（如人工神经网络）通过日益复杂的黑盒架构实现了高预测性能，但这限制了它们在需要透明性、可解释性和公平性的场景中的应用。在此我们介绍R包ONAM，它提供了一种新颖且实用的函数分解实现方法——这是一种通过结构化效应表示来促进黑盒模型可解释性的技术。ONAM实现了一个算法框架，可将预测事后分解为与不同输入特征相关联的组件。该软件包设计注重可用性和效率，包含可视化功能以及评估可解释性的定量指标。作为一种模型无关的方法，它可以应用于广泛的预测模型。文中描述了其数学基础、算法设计和软件架构。
tldr: 提出了R包ONAM，通过正交神经加性模型对黑盒模型的预测进行事后功能分解，将其拆分为与各输入特征相关的组件，并配备可视化和定量评估工具，实现模型无关的可解释性。
en_tdlr: ONAM is an R package that fits orthogonal neural additive models to post-hoc decompose black-box predictions into feature-wise components, offering model-agnostic interpretability with visualization and quantitative assessment tools.
